title: Chikanda
description: Chikanda is a Zambia dish made with peanut butter, ground egusi, cornmeal, banana leaf. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Chikanda-inspired vegetarian loaf: orchid tubers, the defining traditional base, are absent. Ground egusi and cornmeal are not equivalent substitutes.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Wrap the thick mixture securely in clean food-grade banana leaves, then steam until set all the way through; this is only a chikanda-inspired loaf.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
